game: Resident Evil Confidential Report (four-file mobile series)
target: 100% of the selected original four-file mobile route, including documented Japanese features, spoiler-free

areas.name: Selected Four-File Route and Mechanics
areas.location_cue: The four mobile applications, character selection, grid movement, inventory, typewriters, and report logs.
areas.note: Establish clean independent saves before collecting route-specific evidence.

save_backup.title: Clone all four clean applications
save_backup.why: Mobile profiles can overwrite saves across resolution variants.

items.label: Use the Original Four-File Mobile Series

levels.1: Confirm that all four applications belong to the same release family.
levels.2: Use the original Japanese mobile Files 1-4 on compatible hardware or a tested preserved environment.
levels.3: Record each application version and screen profile, start every File once, and verify grid movement, two selectable routes, and persistent local saving. Later regional builds are comparison-only because no exclusive content is documented.

levels.1: Each File has two independent playable routes.
levels.2: Create separate saves for Route A and Route B in Files 1, 2, 3, and 4.
levels.3: Name or document the eight saves before play, capture each empty report log, and never overwrite the opposite route. Preserve a pre-exit copy for every File so missed reports can be repaired.

levels.1: A harmless-looking turn can give every enemy another action.
levels.2: Movement is four-directional; stepping or changing facing advances the room's turn order.
levels.3: Plan two moves ahead, face the intended firing lane before a target closes, use doors as reset points, and avoid exploratory spins in occupied rooms. If a fast target reaches the flank, retreat through the previous doorway instead of spending repeated turns rotating.

levels.1: A target must occupy a valid firing square.
levels.2: Raise the weapon and watch for a valid square within the coloured range pattern.
levels.3: Face the lane, raise the weapon, and fire only when the target's square changes to the valid colour. Count handgun attacks as three rounds, then lower the weapon and reposition before another enemy action.

levels.1: Ordinary supplies can be partly visible behind scenery.
levels.2: Shoot containers that expose a sliver of an item, then collect the revealed pickup.
levels.3: Before leaving each room, inspect crate and box edges for visible item pixels. Stand outside the blast lane, fire once, collect the contents immediately, and record the weapon, ammunition, or healing item before enemies respawn on a later visit.

levels.1: Progress objects advertise themselves differently from ordinary supplies.
levels.2: Inspect each shining object and keep enough inventory room for the complete File chain.
levels.3: Approach every shine from an adjacent grid square, interact, read the item name, and confirm the destination door or fixture accepts it before discarding anything. Save at the nearest typewriter first.

levels.1: Each File contains a safe checkpoint worth preserving.
levels.2: Locate and use the typewriter during each of the four Files; no ribbon is required.
levels.3: Interact with the typewriter before the closing route, create both Route A and Route B backups in separate slots, reload once to verify the save, then continue without overwriting the pre-exit copy.

areas.note: Complete both routes without exposing their narrative outcomes.

areas.name: Four File Key-Item Chains
areas.location_cue: Shining cards, keys, evidence, access items, and contamination equipment along each physical route.
areas.note: Finish each chain before its File exit.

save_backup.title: Save before consuming access items
save_backup.why: A missed chain can block reports or the route exit.

point_of_no_return.title: File route exit
point_of_no_return.why: Confirm the complete key-item chain before crossing it.

levels.1: Several identity cards point toward the rear portion of the facility.
levels.2: Collect all four identity cards and use their rear-entrance clue before either route exits.
levels.3: Search the four-card box, inspect each card, keep the rear-entrance clue, and use it on the corresponding facility route. Confirm the last File 1 report before leaving for the regional police station.

levels.1: The locked school passage and its underground room share a two-part chain.
levels.2: Obtain the passage key, open the locked route, and recover the data disk.
levels.3: Question the frightened key holder, use the passage key near the lecture-hall route, descend through the floor hatch, and collect the data disk in the underground room before accepting the File clear.

levels.1: A dropped object and the vault lead to the evidence pickups.
levels.2: Collect the vial, open the second-floor vault, and take the sample inside.
levels.3: Inspect the dropped vial, follow the central exhibit route to the second-floor vault, use the vault key, examine the open safe and floor, and confirm the sample in inventory before leaving the museum.

levels.1: The lower facility requires both access and contamination preparation.
levels.2: Carry the identity card, vaccine, and research report to the evacuation tunnel.
levels.3: Use the identity card on the lower access route, take the vaccine before passing the contamination door, collect the dropped research report, inspect all three researcher diaries on Route B, then reach the tunnel with the evidence retained.

areas.name: Healing Inventory
areas.location_cue: Breakable containers and route inventories across the facility, school, museum, and lower laboratory.

levels.1: One healing tier belongs in the full inventory audit.
levels.2: Break marked containers and collect Green Herb wherever it appears across the eight routes.
levels.3: Use Green Herb only for light damage so stronger healing remains available for occupied rooms. Record at least one pickup and one controlled use on the inventory ledger.

levels.1: One healing tier belongs in the full inventory audit.
levels.2: Break marked containers and collect Green Herb Plus wherever it appears across the eight routes.
levels.3: Use Green Herb Plus after moderate damage, preferably behind a door before re-entering combat. Record at least one pickup and one controlled use on the inventory ledger.

levels.1: One healing tier belongs in the full inventory audit.
levels.2: Break marked containers and collect First Aid Spray wherever it appears across the eight routes.
levels.3: Reserve the ordinary First Aid Spray for heavy damage that a herb cannot efficiently cover. Record at least one pickup and one controlled use on the inventory ledger.

levels.1: One healing tier belongs in the full inventory audit.
levels.2: Break marked containers and collect First Aid Spray SP wherever it appears across the eight routes.
levels.3: Keep First Aid Spray SP for critical health; it restores the health scale completely. Record at least one pickup and one controlled use on the inventory ledger.

areas.name: Completion and Archive Audit
areas.location_cue: All four applications, eight route saves, 64 report slots, equipment records, and preservation copies.
areas.note: Close the offline evidence while keeping retired services explicit.

save_backup.title: Write-protect two final copies
save_backup.why: The finished four-file archive is the completion artifact.

levels.1: Each of the four applications has two independent routes.
levels.2: Keep a result screen and save for Route A and Route B in every File.
levels.3: Cold-boot each File, load both route saves, confirm its closing result and eight reports, then retain the eight captures beside the application hashes.

levels.1: Every route contributes eight neutral report slots.
levels.2: Count eight reports across each of eight route logs.
levels.3: Open each report screen in order, capture all 64 filled slots without displaying their story text in the spoiler-free guide, and repair any gap from that route's pre-exit save.

levels.1: The surviving appendix preserves a large equipment pool.
levels.2: Acquire and fire every listed handgun, knife, rifle, shotgun, magnum, and launcher code.
levels.3: Because several printed codes are typographically ambiguous, compare the in-game inventory spelling against the internal appendix ledger, retain screenshots privately, and mark discrepancies for source correction rather than renaming the guide entry.

levels.1: Recovery strength changes across four distinct pickup types.
levels.2: Collect and use Green Herb, Green Herb Plus, First Aid Spray, and First Aid Spray SP.
levels.3: Use controlled damage on a duplicate save, record the health scale before and after each tier, then reload so the final route inventory remains intact.

levels.1: Old Java applications and phone saves are vulnerable to profile loss.
levels.2: Keep the four applications, eight saves, and all audit captures together.
levels.3: Hash every application and save, clone the set twice, record the handset or emulator profile, cold-boot all four Files, and confirm every route and report remains readable without relying on the retired Japanese network.
